preconditions.description: Attacker must be authorized (owner or authorized address) to call setFees_base1000 function
Contract must have trading enabled (tradingOpen = true) for swapBack to be triggered
Contract must have swapEnabled = true and balanceOf[address(this)] >= swapThreshold

exploit_hint: As an authorized address, call setFees_base1000 to set burnFee equal to totalFee, making totalETHFee = totalFee - burnFee = 0. Then trigger swapBack() by having sufficient contract token balance and swap enabled, causing division by zero at line 376 where (swapThreshold * liquidityFee)/(totalETHFee * 2) will revert due to division by zero.
